schema.readonly_hint: Read-only by default. Use the edit action to change indexing and masking.
schema.fts_title: Full-text search is configured per field
schema.fts_description: Enable full-text indexing on fields such as message or body to speed up MATCH queries. Existing data is not reindexed automatically.
schema.index_type_hint: Exact match suits IDs and dimensions with few values; full text suits log text; N-gram suits URLs and paths searched by fragment; IP suits addresses searched by network; JSON keys suits JSON fields filtered by one of their keys.
schema.encrypted_hint: This field is encrypted before storage. It cannot be toggled here without making existing data unreadable.
schema.drawer_subtitle: Configure query indexing and result masking without changing the field type.
schema.no_schema: This stream has no schema yet. Fields appear after the first datasource write.

masking.title: Result field masking
masking.description: The backend masks final query results, exports, and API responses. Filtering, sorting, and aggregation still use raw values.
masking.no_global_rule_hint: The field is currently unmasked while inheriting. A future matching global rule will apply automatically.
masking.explicit_none_hint: This field explicitly bypasses global masking for this stream. Select inherit to restore global behavior.
masking.metrics_disabled: Metrics streams do not participate in field masking. Metric values and labels remain unchanged; indexing stays configurable.

retention.days_default_hint: Leave blank to use the platform default of {{days}} days.
retention.default_explanation: Data older than the retention is deleted in the next cleanup; shortening the retention deletes data that is then past it.
retention.downsample_hint: Samples older than the set number of days are rolled up into time buckets: the samples of a series in one bucket become one point (values averaged, delta counts summed), and the original samples are deleted. Queries over long ranges read far less; older data keeps only the bucket resolution.
retention.downsample_after_days_hint: Samples older than this are rolled up; the original samples cannot be recovered afterwards.

usage.write_source_hint: Intake endpoint receiving this stream name
usage.pipelines_hint: Use this stream as a source or target
usage.partial_unavailable: Some dependency services are unavailable; this result may be incomplete.

runtime.basic_hint: Explain the business data and purpose of this stream.
runtime.query_capabilities_hint: Control query access and range. Disabling query access does not stop intake.
runtime.max_query_range_hint: The most hours one query may cover; queries over a longer range are rejected. Empty or 0 means unlimited.
runtime.storage_behavior_hint: Affects how data files are merged and split.
runtime.queryable_hint: When off, this stream keeps receiving and retaining data but is hidden from query selectors and rejected by search. Use it for a source stream that only feeds a routing pipeline.
runtime.daily_merge_hint: An hour after a day ends, its files are merged into one when together they are no larger than the merge target size, so a query over many days opens far fewer files. Retention then applies by the day: a merged file is deleted once its whole day has expired.
runtime.partition_field_hint: New data is split into shards by the values of these fields, and a query with conditions on them reads only the shards that can match. Suits fields nearly every query names, such as a service or tenant. Hash spreads evenly and helps = and IN; first character gives each digit and each letter (any case) a shard and everything else one more, and also helps a LIKE that starts with text, such as 'abc%'. At most two fields, whose shard counts multiply to at most 256.
runtime.partition_too_many: Multiplied by the other field's shards this passes {{max}}.
runtime.field_indexes_hint: Fields that first appear in this stream get an index by their name.
runtime.index_pattern_hint: The first rule in order whose pattern matches the name and whose index suits the field's type applies: * stands for any run of text and ? for one character, as in *_id or http.*. Only fields that appear from now on are affected; change existing fields under Fields and indexes, where an index set for a field by name comes first.

changes.review: The new configuration takes effect immediately after saving.
changes.index_risk: New data is indexed the new way at once; data written before is indexed again in the background, with progress under Indexed field coverage on the overview.
changes.retention_risk: Retention will be reduced to {{days}} days and expired data may be deleted.
changes.query_risk: After query access is disabled, this stream still accepts data but queries and searches are rejected.
changes.downsample_risk: Original samples older than {{days}} days will be rolled up into time buckets and deleted. This cannot be undone.
changes.partition_risk: The split applies to new data only; existing files stay as they are.

validation.index_pattern_length: A field name pattern has at most {{max}} characters.
